Title: Karan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Karan - 34 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Shalini - 58 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Hema - 25 years, daughter
Look: green saree
4. Pallavi - 26 years, friend
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
5. Vinod - 28 years, friend
Look: blue shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Karan stands by the road. Shalini and Vinod stand near him.]

Karan: "What lovely weather!"

[Karan rides his motorbike to the market.]

Karan (gently): "Careful!"

[Karan starts his scooter and rides off.]

Karan: "Careful!"

[Karan gets out of the car.]

Shalini: "Okay, Vinod."

[Karan rides the scooter with Mother sitting behind him.]

Shalini: "Show me too!"

[Karan takes Mother to the market on his motorbike, she sits behind him.]

Karan: "Yes, all right."

Scene 2: The living room - Day

Vinod: "So, here we are!"

[Karan pours himself a whisky and drinks it.]

Karan (gently): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Karan sips red wine.]

Karan: "Okay, Mom."

[Karan drinks a beer.]

Shalini: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Karan staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Shalini: "Exactly right."

[Karan and Mother clink their glasses.]

Karan: "This is amazing!"

Scene 3: The main road - Day

[Karan stands on the road. Hema and Vinod stand near him.]

Hema: "Let's begin."

[Karan starts the car, turns the steering wheel and drives off.]

Karan: "That's great!"

[Karan is driving when he slams on the brakes.]

Hema: "Vinod, listen!"

[Karan steps on the accelerator and speeds away in his car.]

Karan: "I really enjoyed today."
